about.title: About
about.description: Games taught me engagement. Fintech taught me stakes.

hero.title: Games taught me engagement. Fintech taught me stakes.

story: I started in 2017 designing game graphics at Argon Tech in Lahore and, within a year, was leading the gaming department’s UI/UX: writing game design documents, estimating work and shipping features that lifted retention by 30%. Games are unforgiving teachers: if a screen is confusing, players leave in seconds.

That instinct followed me into enterprise SaaS at 360SynergyTech, building anti-money-laundering dashboards and RPA tooling, where the users were analysts instead of players and the cost of confusion was compliance risk. There I learned that the fastest way to ship good design is to hand developers something they don’t have to interpret: it cut build time by a quarter.

Today I’m Senior Product Designer at Cygnus Payments, designing the Compass POS and kiosk ecosystem that restaurants run their whole day on. In between, I’ve freelanced since 2020 for clients in the US, Canada and Europe: apps, real-estate sites, ticketing platforms and a cross-platform shooter.
